title: A J Packaging IPO Details
intro:
A J Packaging IPO is a book build issue of ₹54.00 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 27.50 lakh shares aggregating to ₹49.50 crores and offer for sale of 2.50 lakh shares aggregating to ₹4.50 crores.

A J Packaging IPO opens for subscription on Dec 1, 2026 and closes on Dec 3, 2026. The allotment for the A J Packaging IPO is expected to be finalized on Dec 4, 2026. A J Packaging IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Dec 8, 2026.

A J Packaging IPO is set issue price band at ₹175 to ₹180 per share. The lot size for an application is 800 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,88,000 (1,600 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (2,400 shares), amounting to ₹4,32,000.

D&A Financial Services Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is R.K.Stock Holding Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to A J Packaging IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 1995, A J packaging specializes in manufacturing a diverse range of metal tin cans in multiple shapes such as oval, rectangular, and round, with capacities ranging from 50 grams to 500 grams and 50 ml to 5000 ml. The company offers an extensive product portfolio that includes printed, lacquered, embossed, uniquely shaped, and fully customizable metal cans. These products are designed to meet the packaging requirements of various solid, powdered, and liquid goods. The company operated under B2B model.

The company supply its products to several well-known companies, including CCL Products (India) Limited, Indus Coffee, Vayhan Coffee, Modigold and Beverages, Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities Limited, Haldirams Foods International Private Limited, R K Ganapathi Chettiar, SLN Coffee Private Limited, Marino Foods Private Limited, and Asian Paints Limited.

With manufacturing facilities strategically located in Hyderabad (Telangana), Ghaziabad (Uttar Pradesh), and Khandala (Maharashtra), it efficiently serves leading FMCG brands and the paint industry across both domestic and international markets.
As of June 30, 2026, the Company employed approximately 109 personnel, comprising skilled, semi-skilled, and unskilled workers across various functions.
strengths: Strong relationship with existing customers and suppliers
Focus on Quality Standards and Assurances
The industry-related skills and knowledge can be leveraged to diversify our customer-base and gain wallet share with existing customers by expanding product portfolio
Experienced management team with Industry expertise

faqs.question: How to apply in A J Packaging IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply for the A J Packaging IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method. Steps to Apply for A J Packaging IPO through Zerodha Log in to your Zerodha Kite account. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu. Select the IPO tab and find the A J Packaging IPO in the list. Click Apply next to the IPO. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price. Submit the IPO application. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process. For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review .

faqs.answer: You can apply in A J Packaging IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .
